data.name: Mitul
data.gender_notes: Mitul is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From Sanskrit 'Mitra' meaning friend. This name signifies a bond of friendship, love and companionship. In Hindu mythology, Mitra is one of the divine twins, the Ashvins, who are the gods of friendship, healing, and fertility. The name Mitul carries the meaning “Friend, Companion” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Mitul usually hope their child will grow to embody friend, companion and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name signifying a bond of love and friendship.
data.etymology: Mitul belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend, Companion.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mitul total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mitul embodies a rich cultural heritage that is deeply rooted in the tradition of ancient India. The Sanskrit origin of the name conveys an essential aspect of Indian society, which is a strong emphasis on the importance of personal relationships. Mitul is not just a name, but it is also a reminder of the importance of nurturing and maintaining bonds of love, friendship, and companionship. It is a name that resonates with warmth, sincerity, and loyalty.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hinduism, Mitra is not only a name but also a divine deity. Mitra symbolizes the divine bond of friendship that exists between the individual and the universe. It represents the belief that there is always a divine presence that nurtures and protects us, just like a true friend would. Mitra is also associated with light, truth, and righteousness. The name inspires us to live a life that is filled with truth, light, and friendship, and to always strive towards personal growth and self-improvement.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mitul: Radiating love and harmony, Mitul embodies the pure essence of compassionate relationships. A beacon of unity and peace, they inspire warmth and understanding in the hearts of all they encounter.
